summary: Jeanne Bliss frames a retail leadership approach built on flexibility and gut instinct, illustrating the idea with The Container Store’s Gumby Award, presented by chairman Kip Tindell to the person who is most flexible in helping others. The message emphasizes that a culture of mutual assistance reduces customer friction and enhances the shopping experience, contrasting it with internal competition. Bliss also notes that shared financial information with customers is part of a broader strategy to foster trust and transparency as part of service-oriented leadership.
title: Encouraging Flexibility and Gut in Retail Culture: Gumby Award and Cross-Functional Collaboration
